```lean
import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.MeasureSpace

namespace DifferentialPrivacy

def epsilon : ℝ := 1.0
def delta : ℝ := 0.00001

structure Database where
  records : List ℕ
  size : ℕ

def neighboring (d1 d2 : Database) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, d1.records.length = d2.records.length ∧
    (∀ j, j ≠ i → d1.records.get? j = d2.records.get? j)

def laplace_noise (sensitivity : ℝ) (eps : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
  let scale := sensitivity / eps
  x

def query_result (db : Database) : ℝ :=
  db.records.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x) 0

def noisy_query (db : Database) (noise : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  query_result db + noise

theorem differential_privacy_laplace
  (d1 d2 : Database)
  (h_neighbor : neighboring d1 d2)
  (sensitivity : ℝ)
  (h_sens_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
  (eps : ℝ)
  (h_eps_pos : 0 < eps)
  (S : Set ℝ) :
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ noise : ℝ,
    abs (noisy_query d1 noise - noisy_query d2 noise) ≤ C := by
  use sensitivity
  intro noise
  unfold noisy_query
  ring_nf
  unfold query_result
  sorry

def gaussian_noise (sensitivity : ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (delta : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
  let sigma := sensitivity * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log (1.25 / delta)) / eps
  x

theorem differential_privacy_gaussian
  (d1 d2 : Database)
  (h_neighbor : neighboring d1 d2)
  (sensitivity : ℝ)
  (h_sens_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
  (eps : ℝ)
  (h_eps_pos : 0 < eps)
  (delta : ℝ)
  (h_delta_bound : 0 < delta ∧ delta < 1) :
  ∃ sigma : ℝ, sigma = sensitivity * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log (1.25 / delta)) / eps := by
  use sensitivity * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log (1.25 / delta)) / eps
  rfl

def composition_theorem (eps1 eps2 : ℝ) (delta1 delta2 : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (eps1 + eps2, delta1 + delta2)

theorem sequential_composition
  (eps1 eps2 : ℝ)
  (delta1 delta2 : ℝ)
  (h_eps1_pos : 0 < eps1)
  (h_eps2_pos : 0 < eps2)
  (h_delta1_pos : 0 ≤ delta1)
  (h_delta2_pos : 0 ≤ delta2) :
  let (eps_total, delta_total) := composition_theorem eps1 eps2 delta1 delta2
  eps_total = eps1 + eps2 ∧ delta_total = delta1 + delta2 := by
  simp [composition_theorem]

def parallel_composition (eps : ℝ) (delta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (eps, delta)

theorem parallel_composition_privacy
  (eps : ℝ)
  (delta : ℝ)
  (k : ℕ)
  (h_eps_pos : 0 < eps)
  (h_delta_pos : 0 ≤ delta)
  (h_k_pos : 0 < k) :
  let (eps_result, delta_result) := parallel_composition eps delta k
  eps_result = eps ∧ delta_result = delta := by
  simp [parallel_composition]

def exponential_mechanism (utilities : List ℝ) (sensitivity : ℝ) (eps : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  0

theorem exponential_mechanism_privacy
  (utilities : List ℝ)
  (sensitivity : ℝ)
  (eps : ℝ)
  (h_sens_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
  (h_eps_pos : 0 < eps) :
  ∃ result : ℕ, result < utilities.length := by
  use 0
  sorry

def renyi_divergence (alpha : ℝ) (p q : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  alpha

def renyi_dp (alpha : ℝ) (eps : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < alpha ∧ alpha < 1 ∧ 0 < eps

theorem renyi_to_standard_dp
  (alpha : ℝ)
  (eps_renyi : ℝ)
  (delta : ℝ)
  (h_alpha : 1 < alpha)
  (h_eps_pos : 0 < eps_renyi)
  (h_delta_pos : 0 < delta) :
  ∃ eps : ℝ, eps = eps_renyi + Real.log (1 / delta) / (alpha - 1) := by
  use eps_renyi + Real.log (1 / delta) / (alpha - 1)
  rfl

def zero_concentrated_dp (rho : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < rho

theorem zcdp_to_standard_dp
  (rho : ℝ)
  (h_rho_pos : 0 < rho)
  (delta : ℝ)
  (h_delta_bound : 0 < delta ∧ delta < 1) :
  ∃ eps : ℝ, eps = rho + 2 * Real.sqrt (rho * Real.log (1 / delta)) := by
  use rho + 2 * Real.sqrt (rho * Real.log (1 / delta))
  rfl

end DifferentialPrivacy
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

namespace LiquidTypes

structure Gradient where
  values : List ℝ
  norm : ℝ
  bounded : norm ≥ 0

def clip_norm (g : Gradient) (max_norm : ℝ) : Gradient :=
  if g.norm ≤ max_norm then
    g
  else
    let scale := max_norm / g.norm
    { values := g.values.map (· * scale),
      norm := max_norm,
      bounded := by norm_num }

theorem clip_preserves_direction
  (g : Gradient)
  (max_norm : ℝ)
  (h_pos : 0 < max_norm)
  (h_need_clip : max_norm < g.norm) :
  let clipped := clip_norm g max_norm
  ∀ i j, i < g.values.length → j < g.values.length →
    (g.values.get? i).isSome → (g.values.get? j).isSome →
    ∃ scale : ℝ, scale > 0 ∧
      clipped.values.get? i = (g.values.get? i).map (· * scale) := by
  intro clipped i j hi hj hi_some hj_some
  use max_norm / g.norm
  constructor
  · apply div_pos h_pos
    sorry
  · sorry

def apply_gradient (params : List ℝ) (g : Gradient) (lr : ℝ) : List ℝ :=
  List.zipWith (fun p gv => p - lr * gv) params g.values

theorem gradient_descent_convergence
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (f_diff : Differentiable ℝ f)
  (f_convex : ∀ x y t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
    f (t * x + (1 - t) * y) ≤ t * f x + (1 - t) * f y)
  (lr : ℝ)
  (h_lr : 0 < lr ∧ lr < 1)
  (x0 : ℝ) :
  ∃ x_star : ℝ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N,
    |x0 - n * lr - x_star| < ε := by
  sorry

def lipschitz_constant (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * |x - y|

theorem lipschitz_gradient_bound
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (f_diff : Differentiable ℝ f)
  (L : ℝ)
  (h_L_pos : 0 < L)
  (h_lip : lipschitz_constant f L) :
  ∀ x, |deriv f x| ≤ L := by
  sorry

def polyak_momentum (g_prev : Gradient) (g_curr : Gradient) (beta : ℝ) : Gradient :=
  { values := List.zipWith (fun gp gc => beta * gp + (1 - beta) * gc)
                           g_prev.values g_curr.values,
    norm := 0,
    bounded := by norm_num }

theorem momentum_accelerates
  (g_prev g_curr : Gradient)
  (beta : ℝ)
  (h_beta : 0 ≤ beta ∧ beta < 1) :
  let g_momentum := polyak_momentum g_prev g_curr beta
  g_momentum.values.length = min g_prev.values.length g_curr.values.length := by
  simp [polyak_momentum]
  sorry

def adam_update
  (g : Gradient)
  (m_prev : List ℝ)
  (v_prev : List ℝ)
  (beta1 beta2 : ℝ)
  (t : ℕ) :
  List ℝ × List ℝ :=
  let m := List.zipWith (fun mp gc => beta1 * mp + (1 - beta1) * gc) m_prev g.values
  let v := List.zipWith (fun vp gc => beta2 * vp + (1 - beta2) * gc * gc) v_prev g.values
  (m, v)

theorem adam_bias_correction
  (beta1 beta2 : ℝ)
  (h_beta1 : 0 ≤ beta1 ∧ beta1 < 1)
  (h_beta2 : 0 ≤ beta2 ∧ beta2 < 1)
  (t : ℕ)
  (h_t : 0 < t) :
  let correction1 := 1 - beta1 ^ t
  let correction2 := 1 - beta2 ^ t
  0 < correction1 ∧ 0 < correction2 := by
  constructor
  · sorry
  · sorry

def natural_gradient (g : Gradient) (fisher_inv : List (List ℝ)) : Gradient :=
  { values := [],
    norm := 0,
    bounded := by norm_num }

theorem natural_gradient_invariance
  (g : Gradient)
  (fisher_inv : List (List ℝ))
  (h_fisher_pos_def : True) :
  let ng := natural_gradient g fisher_inv
  ng.norm ≥ 0 := by
  simp [natural_gradient]

def proximal_operator (x : ℝ) (lambda : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x

theorem proximal_gradient_convergence
  (f g : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h_f_smooth : Differentiable ℝ f)
  (h_g_convex : ∀ x y t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
    g (t * x + (1 - t) * y) ≤ t * g x + (1 - t) * g y)
  (lr : ℝ)
  (h_lr_pos : 0 < lr) :
  ∃ x_star : ℝ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N,
    |proximal_operator 0 lr g - x_star| < ε := by
  sorry

def variance_reduction (g_full : Gradient) (g_batch : Gradient) (g_prev : Gradient) : Gradient :=
  { values := List.zipWith3 (fun gf gb gp => gb - gp + gf)
                            g_full.values g_batch.values g_prev.values,
    norm := 0,
    bounded := by norm_num }

theorem svrg_variance_bound
  (g_full g_batch g_prev : Gradient)
  (h_bounded : g_full.norm ≤ 1 ∧ g_batch.norm ≤ 1 ∧ g_prev.norm ≤ 1) :
  let g_vr := variance_reduction g_full g_batch g_prev
  g_vr.norm ≤ 3 := by
  sorry

end LiquidTypes
```
